analysis.title: GS Blekos - Marketcolour + Flow Prime Basket Ideas Memory Europe DCs Puig Interparfums 23 Nov 2026
key_insights: US equities had their worst week since April 2025: SPX -370bps to 6910 with all 11 sectors down (Tech -12.16%, Comm Svcs -9.44%), NDX -561bps to 25028, RTY -276bps to 2581. Decliners outnumbered gainers by more than 15:1.
Semis and AI infrastructure were hit hardest: NVDA -14%, worst week for Semis since 2011, GS AI Semis basket GSCBSMHX -21% and GS Data Centers basket GSTMTDAT -18%.

Europe had a fifth consecutive down day and its worst week since April 2025. ASML NA -9.3% and SX8P European Tech -6.7%, worst since March 2020. Staples (+70bps) and Defensives (unch) were relative winners but are now crowded and at risk.
After 5 weeks of de-grossing, hedge funds re-grossed last week by the largest amount in 4+ years.
Tech looks oversold: NDX at 17x fwd P/E and SOX/Semis at about 12-13x, with valuations at roughly 10-15 year lows and drawdown charts suggesting a lot of work has been done.

Flow: high-touch activity was not commensurate with move size. ETF share of tape exceeded 39%, S&P top-of-book liquidity was $4mm near YTD low, and the desk saw steady LO sell tickets in Semis with buyers frozen. Nasdaq VIX is at its highest since COVID.

CTAs estimated net short -$19bn US equity length (S&P 26th percentile) after selling $57bn over the past month. Forecasts show selling in every scenario next week, with SPX triggers at 7596 / 7540 / 7119.

HF performance: Fundamental L/S down 1.2% (-1.8 SD) on the day, about 75% of funds down, driven by beta. Alpha was +0.3%. Month to date -2.1%, YTD +7.0%. Europe-focused funds -1.3% on the day, -2.3% MTD, +5.4% YTD.
GS sees three bottoming conditions for the S&P: better confidence in AI earnings trajectory, a better macro backdrop such as a dovish Fed signal, and a major decline in positioning.
Basket ideas: prefer Healthcare (GSCBHC27) over Staples (GSXUSTAP), avoid value traps like China Competition (GSXECHNX), and consider High Beta Cyclicals (GSXUHBCY) as a short.
Memory: GIR cut Samsung 2028E OP estimate by 26% and Hynix by 23%. GS analysis says the shares already price zero AI capex growth in 2028E and a further 40% ASP decline versus GIR base case.
Interparfums downgraded Buy to Neutral as upside is largely priced in. Shares are +65% since the 24 Nov 2025 initiation, driven by a re-rating from 16x to 24x 12-month forward P/E.

Puig (Conviction List Buy): organic sales growth expected to accelerate to about 5% from about 4% in FY26, on Rabanne masculine launch, La Favorite global rollout and Charlotte Tilbury expansion into Brazil and Chile.
Europe Utils: on Nov 20 Trump said the US would penalize American companies that build datacenters overseas. This is negative for the equity story of Solaria, Fortum, EDP, RWE and Siemens Energy.
